items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: He was working up the street from us, in a place called the Swingland, with Red McKenzie

ctx.x: He puzzled me when I first met him. Of course that's many years ago. It's a different thing now. But I had asked him was he white, when -- so I said, 'Are you white?' He was sitting there playing one night, we were jamming uptown, on Lenox. We had got off from work. He was working up the street from us, in a place called the Swingland, with Red McKenzie, and he was working up there. So we had intermission about the same time, so we walked around.
